statutory.reasoning: The entity executed 27 wire and ACH transfers, including multiple amounts above $1 million, within a single month, indicating possible structuring or suspicious activity. Under 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g), a covered person must file a suspicious activity report when it knows, suspects, or has reason to suspect a transaction is suspicious. The volume and pattern of transfers satisfy the suspicion threshold, thereby triggering the reporting duty. § 5318(g) requires a SAR to be filed when such activity is observed.
